case_title: AMY K SLOVER VS. STEVAN PEREA

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY SLOVER, AMY K AS TO DEFENDANT PEREA, STEVAN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-05-2012 AT 06:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED FEB-11-2012, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT PEREA, STEVAN

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-05-2012 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF DEFENDANT TO MAR-19-2012 AT 6:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF, ONLY. DEFENDANT CALLED DEPARTMENT 506 AND ASKED FOR A CONTINUANCE BECAUSE OF A FAMILY EMERGENCY WHICH WAS GRANTED BY THE COURT; HE INFORMED THE CLERK THAT HIS MAILING ADDRESS IS DIFFERENT FROM THE ONE LISTED IN THE REGISTER OF ACTION, MAILING ADDRESS HAS BEEN ADDED AS THERE WAS NO CHANGE OF ADDRESS FORM COMPLETED. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF MAR-19-2012 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF MAR-19-2012 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF ONLY. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-19-2012 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SLOVER, AMY K RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT PEREA, STEVAN $10,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $75.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $10,075.00, DEFENDANT NOT PRESENT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
